title: Issued seed state diagram
description: One row of the D1 table games: the seed the server issues for a game, so it can replay the game before listing its score. A seed is claimed at most once.
machine: A row of the D1 table games (worker/schema.sql), written by worker/index.ts

states.description: Inserted by POST api/game with used = 0; its id and seed go to the browser.
used = 1: a verified submission claimed it, and its score is recorded.
Removed while unused and more than 24 hours old.

transitions.guard: the row is unused and under 24 hours old, and the controls replay a whole game for as many players as names were sent
transitions.action: UPDATE games SET used = 1 WHERE id = ? AND used = 0; insert the replayed score.

transitions.guard: created more than SEED_LIFETIME_MS (24 hours) ago
transitions.action: DELETE FROM games WHERE used = 0 AND created < now − 24 h.
